summary: Post-market read on the 2026-08-31 US session (fact layer 2026-09-01T03:02:40Z): the composite risk score eased 0.31 to 41.75 and held at caution inside a goldilocks regime, but the internals pulled the other way. Macro is the only stretched leg and it is rising, at 62.84: the 10Y real rate printed 2.42 in the 98.39th percentile and the 10Y yield 4.73 in the 98.48th, while the 2Y repriced to 4.34 from 4.2 and flattened the 10Y-2Y curve to 0.39. Breakevens did not follow - 5Y5Y forward 2.31 and the 10Y breakeven 2.31 - so this was a real-rate, policy-repricing move rather than an inflation scare, and FedWatch carries an implied rate of 3.965 with a hike bias. The tape masked it: Tesla closed +5.5054 at 367.95, Micron +2.7732 at 958.73, Nvidia +1.4847 at 220.78, AMD +1.104 and Broadcom +0.4203, with autos and autonomous driving both +5.5054 and semis +1.4455 leading the themes. Underneath, structure weakened - new lows ratio 0.071, breadth above the 200-day 0.6452, small-cap relative 0.0832 - and relayed Chinese coverage (East Money via RSSHub, second-hand) reported all three US indices closing lower, matching the triggered spy_down signal at -0.299: the advance narrowed rather than broadened. Overnight a second risk arrived - a tanker struck in Hormuz and Iranian strikes on two American bases in Jordan, with Trump vowing a hard response (CNBC, importance 52.1) - a supply-side shock landing on a curve already priced for tightening, while the dollar firmed to 118.7479. The offsets are still real: HY OAS 2.6 in the 0.51 percentile, IG OAS 0.79, VIX 14.43 and realized vol 9.397 keep volatility at 13.77, and price remains 7.9947 above the 200-day. The clearest casualty was the A-share AI supply chain, where every tracked name closed lower, from -2.4306 to -4.573. Net: a narrowing, rate-pressured advance inside a still-benign credit and volatility backdrop - caution earned by the rate anchor and by breadth, not by credit.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The rate anchor is the binding constraint: the macro dimension rose to 62.84 and is the only stretched leg - the 10Y real rate at 2.42 sits in the 98.39th percentile and the 10Y yield at 4.73 in the 98.48th, while the 2Y repriced to 4.34 from 4.2 and flattened the 10Y-2Y curve to 0.39.

This is a real-rate repricing, not an inflation one: the 5Y5Y forward breakeven at 2.31 and the 10Y breakeven at 2.31 did not follow, while the 10Y real rate rose to 2.42 - the market is pricing the policy path, not an inflation risk premium.

Leadership narrowed while the index closed lower, taking the equity structure score to 46.67: new lows ratio 0.071, breadth above the 200-day 0.6452, small-cap relative just 0.0832 and semis relative -11.7683.

A fresh supply-side geopolitical risk arrived overnight: a tanker was struck in Hormuz and Iran attacked two American bases in Jordan, with Trump vowing a hard response (CNBC, importance 52.1), while the broad dollar index firmed to 118.7479 - an oil and dollar shock together is the worst pairing for a curve already priced for hikes.

supporting_signals.claim: The A-share AI supply chain de-rated across the board at the CN close: 300475.sz -4.573, 002156.sz -4.4145, 001309.sz -3.8946 and 688825.sh -2.4306 - every tracked name lower.
Global conditions tightened with the dollar: the broad dollar index rose to 118.7479 from 118.3583, the euro slipped to 1.1598 from 1.1654 and the yen to 159.97 from 159.26.
Month-end plumbing showed up in the reverse repo, which jumped to 6.726 from 0.175 and carries a 69.16 indicator risk score, yet SOFR only edged to 3.65 from 3.64 - no funding stress.

The model's own agreement weakened: confidence 0.9088 rests on data quality 1.0 and coverage 0.93 but a consistency factor of only 0.6838 - exactly what a falling composite with a rising macro leg produces.

Cross-asset confirmation sits at 0.5 and is still the single largest contributor at 7.5 points, but it is a proxy carried at a 0.8 discount - the biggest driver of the score is also its least direct measurement.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit refuses to confirm any stress: HY OAS tightened to 2.6 from 2.63 and sits in the 0.51 percentile - effectively the tightest in the sample - with IG OAS unchanged at 0.79.

Volatility stayed asleep through the repricing: VIX eased to 14.43 from 14.51 and sits in the 17.06 percentile, realized vol is 9.397, and the volatility dimension holds at 13.77 and falling - hedges remain cheap.
The composite itself eased rather than tightened: 41.75 after a 0.31 decline on the day, with the week at -3.83 and the month at -0.14.
The trend structure is intact: price sits 7.9947 above the 200-day, the 52-week drawdown is only -1.3922 and 3-month momentum is still positive at 1.1219.
The AI complex was bid, not sold: Tesla +5.5054 to 367.95, Micron +2.7732 to 958.73, Nvidia +1.4847 to 220.78, AMD +1.104 and Broadcom +0.4203, with semis +1.4455 and AI infrastructure +0.451.

bull_case.title: Bull case: a rate-led pause with credit intact
points: Neither credit nor volatility confirms stress: HY OAS 2.6 in the 0.51 percentile, IG OAS 0.79, VIX 14.43 and realized vol 9.397.
The composite is still falling - 41.75, -0.31 on the day and -3.83 on the week - so the tape is de-rating duration, not repricing risk.
Trend is intact: price 7.9947 above the 200-day with a 52-week drawdown of only -1.3922.
If Hormuz de-escalates and the 2026-09-04 payroll print cools, the 2Y can retrace from 4.34 and the AI complex keeps its bid.

base_case.title: Base case: caution holds, leadership stays narrow
points: The composite oscillates around 41.75, with macro at 62.84 offset by liquidity at 28.76 and volatility at 13.77.
Rates stay the swing factor: the 10Y at 4.73 and the real rate at 2.42 near the top of their distributions cap multiple expansion without breaking trend.
Breadth stays thin - new lows 0.071, breadth above the 200-day 0.6452, small-cap relative 0.0832 - so index gains keep depending on a handful of mega caps.

bear_case.title: Bear case: real rates and an oil shock at once
points: With the 10Y real rate at 2.42 in the 98.39th percentile and the 10Y at 4.73 in the 98.48th, there is no valuation buffer left if the curve prices further hikes.
A Hormuz supply shock pushes headline inflation into a hike-biased curve - precisely the combination that breaks the goldilocks read (CNBC, importance 52.1).
Thin breadth is the transmission channel: new lows at 0.071 and small-cap relative at 0.0832 mean a mega-cap stumble has nothing behind it.
Watch HY OAS at 2.6 from the 0.51 percentile - it can only widen from here, and that widening is the confirmation the score currently lacks.
